links.outcome: LLM melanoma treatment recommendations rated against real MDT decisions across five domains
links.effect: ChatGPT-5 Thinking performed best, followed by ChatGPT-4o; Gemini 2.5 Pro and DeepSeek-V3.2 rated less favorably; differences significant across all domains, largest in adjuvant/systemic treatment scenarios.
links.quote: ChatGPT-5 Thinking showed the strongest and most consistent overall performance, followed by ChatGPT-4o, while Gemini 2.5 Pro and DeepSeek-V3.2 were rated less favorably.

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation comparing LLM-generated treatment recommendations for melanoma patients with real-world multidisciplinary tumor board decisions.
